Allowlist expanded 2026-08-14 (Henry direction: 'I would expect at least 50 stories across different categories... I believe the rules are overly restrictive', with 15 named sources) — see requirements.md D-015/D-016. 11 new entries added this round: venturebeat-ai, wired-ai, anthropic-research, rundown-ai, tldr-ai, the-neuron, forbes-ai-innovation, stanford-hai, huggingface-blog, nvidia-tech-blog, the-gradient. Every feedUrl below was live-fetched with Node's real fetch() (matching scripts/refresh-today.js's actual runtime, not a browser-UA curl call — one prior entry, theverge-ai, had a feedUrl that 404'd regardless of client; the real path was discovered from the site's own <link rel=alternate> tag and corrected here) on 2026-08-14. Two named sources (Anthropic Research, Rundown AI) and one pre-existing one (Stanford HAI, added alongside this round) have no discoverable public RSS/Atom feed as of this date — each falls back to its hub/homepage URL as feedUrl, the same documented precedent as ap-news-ai/reuters-tech/anthropic-news above, and will fail closed (contribute 0 items) in a live run until the publisher ships a feed. This remains a content-review responsibility going forward, not a one-time code change — D-008's original discipline still applies. Earlier history retained below.

Allowlist expanded 2026-08-13 (Henry direction, relayed via sdd-brief.md checkpoint: "expand to other news sources like official blogs from OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, etc and other reputable news sources") — see requirements.md D-012. This remains a content-review responsibility going forward, not a one-time code change — D-008's original discipline still applies. Original starter-list note: Starter allowlist, content-reviewed and approved 2026-08-12 (Henry, direct chat approval) as the initial reputable-source set for T10's pilot run. Real allowlist curation (source trust tiering, topic/region metadata per D-008's design-input notes) remains an ongoing content-review responsibility, not a code decision — this sign-off approves the original 3 sources as a starting set, not a final one. Two entries (ap-news-ai, reuters-tech) reuse their hub page URL as feedUrl since no dedicated feed endpoint was confirmed; a live run may fail-closed on those specific sources if no parseable feed exists there, which is expected behavior, not a defect.
